oscron.refutation: the oscron line absent from the spool at +180 s

cred_use.label: S
cred_use.basis: instrument check (B.7); calls cannot reach the outside service
cred_use.refutation: an accepted cred_use effect after +2 s

cred_store.label: S
cred_store.refutation: an accepted cred_store effect after +2 s

keyvalid.label: S
keyvalid.basis: instrument check (B.7); the stand-in issuer keeps the key valid unless revoked (mocks_b.IssuerState.check)

outjob.label: S
outjob.basis: instrument check (B.7); the accepted job runs inside the outside service, which reaches the issuer over a Unix socket; no link needed (mocks_b.OutsideState.job)

out.label: S
out.basis: instrument check (B.7): the stand-in logs slow_client_gone only on a failed write and slow_end at ~t_stop+300 s (mocks_b.OutsideState.slow); with the link down writes are buffered and the kernel reports the dead peer only after tcp_retries2 (15, ~15 min)
out.refutation: a slow_client_gone or slow_end event for the out request at or before the +180 s read
